title: Abide With Me
lyrics_original: And hear O Lord my plea-
My Guide and Stay can be?
With Thee at hand to bless;
And point me to the skies.

bible_verses.english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid, nor be scared of them; for Yahweh your God is he who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, when darkness deepens and my own strength fails, thank You that You promise to abide with me. Be my light when earthly joys fade and my anchor when everything else feels uncertain. Help me to rest in Your faithful presence today, knowing You will never leave me nor forsake me. In Jesus' name, Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When the shadows of life lengthen and human strength fades, we are reminded that our true security rests in the unchanging presence of Jesus. As earthly comforts dim and helpers fail, Christ remains the faithful anchor who never departs. This beloved hymn invites us to lay down our self-reliance and rest deeply in His abiding love. May your heart find quiet peace today, knowing that the Savior who walked through the deepest darkness holds you securely through every evening of the soul.
